==Description==
'''Null Scout Charm''' is an exclusive charm introduced in the [[Null & Void Event#Null & Void Battle Pass|Null & Void Battle Pass]] as a reward for reaching Level 19 on the regular track. It had a cost of {{GumDrops|460}} or {{Robux|46}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{GumDrops|4,105}} or {{Robux|996}}. Prior to the 20% discount, it had a cost of {{Robux|58}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{Robux|1,255}}.

==Appearance==
'''Null Scout Charm''' appearance is based on the [[Null Scout]] enemy. It has [[Null Scout]] standing on a platform with a few spikes coming out of it. It can be seen walking. Black and purple smoke comes out of the charm.

The color of '''Null Scout Charm''' depends on the username color of the player in the chat, though it is purple in its inventory preview.
